subject: PrismAI POC: success metrics, trial plan, and ownership
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@prismai.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@prismai.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: PrismAI discovery recap + proposed POC success metrics

Thanks for the time this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and an initial POC proposal so we can align on measurable success and owners before the kickoff.

Discovery highlights (short):
- Target product flows: intent classification + short-form summarization of user transcripts.
- Current constraints: 50–70 concurrent users during peak; backend requests are small (avg 120 tokens).
- Security: SOC2 required, customer data must not be retained beyond 30 days without consent.

Proposed POC objective: validate that Redwood inference can meet PrismAI's latency, throughput, cost, and quality targets for the two production flows over a 2-week trial with representative traffic.

Success metrics (initial):
- Latency: p95 end-to-end inference < 200 ms (target) with initial stretch goal p95 < 150 ms.
- Throughput: steady-state 60 request/s (peak 120 req/s optional — see note below).
- Cost: target <= $0.0008 per token (equivalent to ~$0.80 per 1k tokens) and aim for cost-per-response <$0.06 for typical summaries.
- Quality: intent classification accuracy >= 92% on Prism-provided label set; summarization ROUGE-L >= 0.60 and user-rated helpfulness >= 4.2/5; hallucination incidents < 2% by sample audit.

Evaluation plan (2-week cadence):
1) Smoke + env setup (2 business days): private VPC connectivity, test harness, sample prompts loaded, short smoke tests.
2) Benchmark (5 business days): run steady traffic at target throughput, measure latency/throughput curves, verify cost numbers with token accounting.
3) Quality & user evaluation (5 business days): run labeled datasets and a small human review of summaries; capture error types and hallucination samples.
4) Handoff + deck (2 business days): consolidate results, recommended configuration (batching/quantization), and runbook for production.

Ownership & roles:
- Redwood: Michael Grant (sales lead) — overall POC coordination, commercial acceptance.
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (platform lead) — test harness, telemetry, ops runbook.
- PrismAI: Amit Shah (eng lead) — dataset + ground truth; Lena Ortiz (PM) — acceptance criteria and user eval logistics.

Operational notes:
- We recommend starting with Dedicated capacity for the benchmark window to keep variance low.
- We'll instrument token-level costs and provide a per-route cost breakdown.
- We need a short security checklist completed before any production-like data is used (SOC2 evidence, retention settings).

Attachments: prism_trial_plan.xlsx (detailed milestones), prism_sample_prompts.json (example prompts + labeled set).

Ask: Can you confirm the throughput target (60 req/s) and the labeled dataset availability by EOD Thursday so we can lock the schedule? If that works, I'll circulate a one-page mutual action plan and proposed kickoff for Monday 2028-03-20.

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Grant | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Amit Shah <amit@prismai.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@prismai.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-15T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrismAI discovery recap + proposed POC success metrics

Thanks Michael — appreciated. Confirming we can provide the labeled intent set and sample transcripts by EOD Thursday. A couple of quick asks/clarifications:

- Throughput: for the first run, can we target 60 req/s steady-state instead of 120? We'll want to iterate up after baseline results. 60 should cover our normal peak for the MVP.
- Cost target: instead of per-token, can we frame the business ask as cost-per-response (we expect most responses to be ~120 tokens); target <$0.06/response keeps the economics clear for the product team.
- Security checklist: we can complete a short questionnaire but need confirmation on data retention configuration within Redwood Private (30 days default).

Also attaching an internal Prism note about the human-eval cohort (small group of 10 power users).

Looking forward — Amit
Amit Shah | Head of Engineering | PrismAI

On Mar 15, 2028, at 10:12 AM, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the time this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and an initial POC proposal so we can align on measurable success and owners before the kickoff.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Amit Shah <amit@prismai.ai>
Date: 2028-03-15T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PrismAI discovery recap + proposed POC success metrics

Michael — thanks, this is a good starting point. A few operational items I want to add so the benchmark gives us reliable numbers:

- Warmup & cache: include a 24-hour warmup for KV caches where applicable, and run a short warm traffic window before the benchmark to avoid cold-cache thunks affecting p95.
- Dedicated pool: agree we should use Dedicated (reserved) capacity during the benchmark window to minimize noisy neighbors. We can spin up a small pool for the 5-day benchmark.
- Measurement: we'll capture p50/p95/p99 latency, median & tail throughput, success codes, token counts, and per-route cost. We'll also run a small stress curve (10% increments) to find the throughput knee.
- Instrumentation: request that PrismAI include a stable request-id in payloads so we can correlate traces and the human-eval samples.
- Security: I'll send over a trimmed SOC2 evidence bundle and a one-page retention config for Redwood Private. Please confirm Prism's retention policy is set to 30 days for PII by default.

I've attached test-harness.spec to this note (simple perf harness + measurement endpoints). I'll make Mar 18 available for a short run-through with your eng team.

Marissa Cole
Platform Lead, Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-03-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Updated mutual action plan + next steps (kickoff target Mon 2028-03-20)

Amit / Lena — thanks for the quick confirmation. I've consolidated the notes from Marissa and Amit and attached a one-page mutual action plan (also linked below). High level next steps:

- PrismAI to deliver: labeled intent set + sample transcripts (EOD Thu 2028-03-17), human-eval cohort details, and confirmation of 30-day retention.
- Redwood to deliver: test harness + Dedicated pool config, SOC2 evidence excerpt, and runbook for instrumentation (by Fri 2028-03-17).
- Mutual: agree on final KPIs: p95 < 200 ms (initial), 60 req/s steady-state, cost-per-response < $0.06, intent accuracy >= 92%, ROUGE-L >= 0.60, hallucination < 2%.

Please review and reply with a quick OK or a single-line redline by COB 2028-03-18 so we can lock the kickoff for Mon 2028-03-20. If you prefer, we can do a 15-min pre-kickoff sync on Fri 2028-03-17 — I can schedule.

Mutual Action Plan (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PrismPOCdrive
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/PrismAI

Attachments: prism_trial_plan.xlsx, prism_sample_prompts.json, test-harness.spec

Thanks,
Michael Grant | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
